newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Goodale sees CWB future clear in weeks.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Goodale sees CWB future clear in weeks.

text.p: Canada's Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale on Monday said he hoped to have a clear direction for the future of the Canadian Wheat Board before the Canadian Thanksgiving holiday on October 14.

"I hope to have the opportunity to discuss my conclusions and recommendations with my cabinet colleagues in the days immediately ahead, and I would hope ... to be in a position to indicate the direction that we intend to take before Thanksgiving," Goodale told the House of Commons while answering a question from the opposition.

The Western Grain Marketing Panel suggested in July removing the CWB's monopoly on feed barley exports, pricing up to a quarter of milling wheat on the spot market and revamping the agency's corporate structure.
